_comment: Exhibitions entered by hand, for shows no scraper can reach: appointment-only
spaces, unlisted addresses, Instagram-only galleries with no business account.
main.py merges these into seen.json on every run. New entries are inserted and
notified once; existing entries have their content refreshed but their status is
left alone, so sweep_closed and the 30-day auto-close in build_data still apply.
Dates must be full ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). Never write a bare month and day and let
something else guess the year. Leave end_date empty only when the show genuinely
has no announced end; build_data closes an entry 30 days after start in that case.
Leave address and suburb empty for spaces that deliberately do not publish one.
